close_reason: Fixed: collapsed (is_direct_create: bool, direct_contact_id_str: Option<String>) pair to single direct_contact_id_str: Option<String>. Some = direct create; if let Some branch replaces is_direct_create guard.
description:
File:/home/mark/PROJECT/JMAP/crate-jmap-mail-server/src/chat.rs:313
Issue: is_direct_create and direct_contact_id_str are declared uninitialized on lines 313-314 and then assigned in every match arm (ChatKind::Direct, ChatKind::Channel, _). The Rust compiler enforces initialization, but a reader must trace all three arms to be sure of the invariant. The paired variables are always used together: direct_contact_id_str is Some iff is_direct_create is true. This is a hidden coupling that is not expressed in the type.
Fix: Replace the two variables with a single Option<String> named direct_contact_id (Some = is a direct create, None = not). This collapses the boolean + Option pair into one type-safe value.
title: is_direct_create/direct_contact_id_str late-init pattern
